findings.claim: Flex 預期 FY26 資料中心營收約 65 億美元、年增至少 35%、占總營收約 25%；資料中心不是獨立申報部門，全年指引只在年初給、年底更新
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks: How is Flex Accelerating Its Expansion in the Data Center Market?; Seeking Alpha: Flex signals at least 35% data center revenue growth for FY26
findings.excerpt: The company is on track to generate roughly $6.5 billion in data center revenue this year, representing at least 35% year-over-year growth and accounting for 25% of its total revenues.

findings.claim: Flex 同期消費相關終端市場疲弱，部分抵銷資料中心成長
findings.source: Flex 財報摘要（搜尋結果彙整，Q2/Q3 FY26）

findings.claim: Q4 2026 零組件市場分析稱產業呈結構性分化而非 2021 式全面缺料；另有來源稱 2026 缺料為選擇性、特定 SKU，記憶體（AI 驅動）最可能延續到 2027 以後，被動元件交期拉長到 26–40 週
findings.source: Utmel: 2026 Q4 Electronic Components Market Analysis Report

findings.claim: Benchmark 稱近期不需新增大型廠房，僅擴建現有廠址（EMS 同業產能紀律訊號；日期不明）
findings.source: Circuits Assembly: No expansion plans for Benchmark

supply_demand_durability.note: 未找到 2027–2028 EMS 業界共識或明確產能釋出時程；as_of 為推估發布日。Celestica 共識（明年營收約 +57%）與 Jabil 低個位數 CAGR 來自二手網站，Flex FY27 EPS 共識僅知近 60 日上修，無數字。
